**Review of the search ad**

Headline: "Plastic-Free Tea Bags" – supported by the allowlist (tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable). Fine.

Description, sentence 1: "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable." – an allowed claim, stated as written. Fine.

Description, sentence 2: "Recommended by nutritionists." – This is not on the claims allowlist. It implies professional endorsement, which is an unsubstantiated testimonial/authority claim, and it also carries a health-adjacent implication. We have no record of any nutritionist recommending the product, so it must be removed or replaced with a backed claim (e.g. "Certified organic by the Soil Association" or "Free UK delivery on orders over £25").

Other checks: no invented stats, superlatives, guarantees, urgency, or missing disclosures. The copy is short and not generic filler.

**Verdict:** Do not publish as written. Remove "Recommended by nutritionists."
